# Triple Crown Group

> AI consultants serving Greater Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky. We audit, build,
> and train AI for sales and marketing teams at small and mid-sized businesses.

Triple Crown Group is a service-area business founded by Noah Chaney. We work on-site
across Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties in Kentucky and Hamilton County in Ohio.
We are not affiliated with Triple Crown Consulting, a separate technology staffing firm.

- Contact: Noah Chaney, Founder
- Phone: (859) 414-4178
- Email: nchaney@triplecrown.group
- Service area: Cincinnati, Covington, Newport, Florence, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger,
  Crestview Hills, Blue Ash, Mason, West Chester, Liberty Township

## Services

- AI audit: assessment of where a sales or marketing team is today and where AI genuinely helps
- AI tool audit: which AI tools actually fit the business, including ones already owned
- AI training for sales and marketing teams: hands-on adoption, not slideware
- Custom AI agents: built around a specific business, workflow, sales rep, or marketer
- AI agents for leadership: reporting and roll-up automation
- Ongoing AI advisory: continuing support as teams and tools change
